title: Station health event v1
description: Published on txori/v1/{station_id}/health with QoS 1 and retain true. Because it is retained, the consumer must ALWAYS check observed_at before showing it: a retained message from hours ago still arrives intact to whoever subscribes. PROVISIONAL in its list of fields until Erik confirms what he wants to monitor (docs/interfaces.md, issue #24).

observed_at.description: Instant of the measurement. Essential to expire a retained message.

cpu_percent.description: Average CPU usage over the interval, as a percentage of the whole device. null if it could not be measured.

memory_used_bytes.description: Used memory in bytes. In bytes and not MB so as not to carry a rounding between producer and dashboard.

cpu_temperature_c.description: SoC temperature in degrees Celsius. The range bounds absurd readings from a faulty sensor.

disk_free_bytes.description: Free space on the volume where the database lives. It is the threshold that triggers degraded mode (ADR 0007, issue #26).

uptime_seconds.description: Seconds since system boot. Makes it possible to tell a reboot from a mere reconnection.

services.description: Status declared for each known service. It is what the monitor believes, not a check by the consumer.
